codeMetrics.name: codeMetrics
codeMetrics.runtimeType: { linesOfCode?: number; linesOfComments?: number; complexity?: number; maintainabilityIndex?: number; technicalDebt?: number; codeSmells?: number; duplicatedLines?: number; testCoverage?: number; }

dependencies.name: dependencies
dependencies.runtimeType: { name: string; version?: string; type: "import" | "require" | "include" | "reference"; scope: "internal" | "external" | "system"; required: boolean; }

codeQuality.name: codeQuality
codeQuality.runtimeType: { score?: number; issues?: { type: "error" | "warning" | "info"; severity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical"; rule: string; message: string; line?: number; column?: number; suggestion?: string; }; lastAnalyzed?: Date; analyzer?: string; }

testInfo.name: testInfo
testInfo.runtimeType: { hasTests: boolean; testFiles?: string[]; testCoverage?: number; testCount?: number; passingTests?: number; failingTests?: number; lastTestRun?: Date; }

documentation.name: documentation
documentation.runtimeType: { hasDocumentation: boolean; docFormat?: "jsdoc" | "pydoc" | "javadoc" | "rustdoc" | "godoc" | "other"; apiDocumentation?: string; readme?: string; examples?: string[]; completeness?: number; }

buildInfo.name: buildInfo
buildInfo.runtimeType: { buildable: boolean; buildTool?: string; buildConfig?: string; outputFiles?: string[]; lastBuild?: Date; buildStatus?: "success" | "failed" | "pending"; buildErrors?: string[]; }

securityScan.name: securityScan
securityScan.runtimeType: { scanned: boolean; scannedAt?: Date; vulnerabilities?: { severity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical"; type: string; description: string; line?: number; cwe?: string; recommendation?: string; }; securityScore?: number; }

gitInfo.name: gitInfo
gitInfo.runtimeType: { repository?: string; branch?: string; commit?: string; author?: string; lastCommit?: Date; commitMessage?: string; changedLines?: number; additions?: number; deletions?: number; }

codeReviews.name: codeReviews
codeReviews.runtimeType: { reviewId: string; reviewer: string; status: "pending" | "approved" | "changes_requested" | "rejected"; comments?: { line: number; comment: string; type: "suggestion" | "issue" | "compliment"; }; reviewedAt?: Date; }

performanceMetrics.name: performanceMetrics
performanceMetrics.runtimeType: { executionTime?: number; memoryUsage?: number; cpuUsage?: number; benchmarks?: { name: string; value: number; unit: string; timestamp: Date; }; }[]

refactoringSuggestions.name: refactoringSuggestions
refactoringSuggestions.runtimeType: { type: "extract_method" | "rename" | "move_class" | "inline" | "extract_constant"; description: string; startLine: number; endLine: number; priority: "low" | "medium" | "high"; estimatedEffort: string; }
